services.desc: Frisky Mermaid is Pensacola Beach’s highest-rated pontoon boat rental company - 3,000 five-star Google reviews and an all-tritoon fleet that’s a cut above anything else on the water. Whether you’re planning a half-day cruise through the Santa Rosa Sound, a full day out to Sand Island, or a multi-day adventure along the Gulf Coast, we have a rental built for your itinerary. Choose your duration below and book online in minutes. All rentals include life jackets, safety equipment, GPS, area maps with marked anchorage spots, and a full safety orientation. services.desc: Pensacola Beach sits on some of the clearest, most marine-rich water on the Gulf Coast - and the best way to experience it is from below the surface. Frisky Mermaid's snorkel tours and beach excursions take small groups out to the crystal-clear waters of Santa Rosa Sound, secluded beaches only reachable by boat, and Sand Island. Whether you're looking for a quick snorkel adventure or a full day on the water, we have an excursion built for your group. Grab your mask and fins - we’re taking you where the marine life is.
